negative_findings.description: No Slovenian Indeed domain (si.indeed.com / indeed.si) surfaced in search; results resolved to indeed.com generic 'Slovenia' keyword queries with mostly irrelevant global postings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Indeed appears to have no dedicated SI property; keyword-based indeed.com queries return very noisy results and are not a reliable SI banking hiring feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The brief assumed 'Indeed SI' exists; collection design should rely on Optius/MojeDelo/Careerjet.si instead and treat Indeed as optional low-yield.

negative_findings.description: Glassdoor results for 'NLB' are dominated by NLB Services (an unrelated Indian IT staffing firm, ~850 reviews) and NLB Corp, not NLB Group (Ljubljana, employer id E553398).
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the E553398 profile is the Slovenian bank; all other NLB profiles are false positives.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated employer-review collection keyed on the string 'NLB' will ingest wrong-company data and corrupt sentiment/headcount inferences.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovenian for search-firm placement announcements ('imenovanje', 'izvršno iskanje kadrov') returned firm marketing pages but no named placement-announcement pages for SI banking roles.
negative_findings.result_summary: SI-domiciled search firms (Competo, Trescon, Amrop Adria, Kadring) appear to publish service descriptions rather than named client placements; only international networks (Pedersen & Partners, Boyden) reliably publish named placement news.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed recruiters publicise placements; in SI that mainly holds for the international networks, so collection weight should shift there plus LinkedIn individual posts.

negative_findings.description: Kadring's own website was never returned in results; its URL was inferred from the firm name and is not confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kadring is corroborated as a real SI recruitment agency by secondary directories, but no first-party page was observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The candidate entry must be liveness-verified before being trusted; do not treat the inferred URL as confirmed.

negative_findings.description: The core channel of this cell - LinkedIn individual 'new role' posts - is not reachable anonymously and cannot be enumerated by search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only company-page shells surfaced via si.linkedin.com; individual post-level content was not observable in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The earliest leadership-move signal in this cell is structurally hard to automate; budget for analyst monitoring or a licensed data source.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn company pages were confirmed for NLB Group, Banka Slovenije, Intesa Sanpaolo SI, Bankart and Halcom, but not for OTP banka Slovenija, SKB (OTP), Addiko Bank, Delavska hranilnica, Gorenjska banka, Sberbank successor entities, or SI PSPs/fintechs (Mercury/Sedmi val, Payten SI, Nexi SI entity).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Complete the LinkedIn + careers-page actor map for all licensed SI banks, savings banks and payment institutions from the Banka Slovenije register, then attach one job-board employer page per actor.

coverage_gaps.description: No ATS-level feeds identified (Workday/SmartRecruiters/Successfactors tenants used by SI banks), which would give structured, dated, machine-readable vacancy data instead of scraped boards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect each bank's careers page for the underlying ATS host and register those endpoints as first-class sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language searching worked for job boards and media, but no local-language equivalent was found for 'placement announcement' as a genre; the glossary term set for recruiter announcements in Slovenian remains thin.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the SL glossary (npr. 'nov izziv', 'z veseljem sporočam', 'prevzel vodenje', 'imenovan za predsednika uprave', 'nova sodelavka/sodelavec') and re-run post-level searches once an authenticated LinkedIn path exists.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell can surface claimed moves but not confirm them; statutory confirmation of bank board changes lives in AJPES/court register and Banka Slovenije notices, which are outside this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a hand-off so every leadership move captured here is validated against the registry/regulator cell before it enters any conclusion.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value channels in this cell (LinkedIn, Glassdoor) both prohibit scraping and gate content, so no compliant automated collection route has been established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate licensed alternatives (LinkedIn Talent Insights/Sales Navigator, Revelio/Lightcast-type talent datasets) or formalise a manual analyst rota with a fixed weekly checklist.

brief: For Slovenian banking and payments, the professional-network and talent-intelligence layer splits cleanly into three tiers: gated but highest-signal social channels (LinkedIn company pages for NLB Group, Banka Slovenije, Intesa Sanpaolo SI, Bankart and Halcom; Glassdoor employer profiles), openly crawlable Slovenian job boards (Optius with a dedicated Bančništvo/Finance category, MojeDelo, Careerjet.si) plus first-party careers pages such as Bankart's, and an executive-search tier of Ljubljana-based firms (Competo/Glasford, Amrop Adria, TRESCON/CFR, Boyden Slovenia, Kadring) alongside international networks (Pedersen & Partners, Stanton Chase Belgrade). The cell's founding assumption needs a correction: local SI search firms publish service marketing rather than named placements, so named placement announcements come mostly from the international networks, while local moves surface in Slovenian media round-ups such as siol.net. Two structural constraints dominate collection design - LinkedIn and Glassdoor are auth-walled and scraping-prohibited, and there is no Slovenian Indeed property - so the practical automated backbone is the SL job boards, with LinkedIn handled by analyst monitoring or a licensed dataset. Every leadership move found here should be treated as a claim pending confirmation against the registry/regulator cell.
